description: This is a Java source file defining the ProductServices class in the OFBiz framework. It contains various static methods for managing products, variants, features, associations, and related media such as images. It includes functionality for finding product variants, creating virtual products, attaching images, and other product-related operations.

classes.name: ProductServices
classes.description: Contains static methods for managing product entities, variants, features, associations, and media operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: prodFindAllVariants
methods.description: Creates a collection of variant products related to a specified product ID.

methods.name: prodFindSelectedVariant
methods.description: Finds products containing specific features among variants of a product.

methods.name: prodFindFeatureTypes
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence of feature types associated with a product.

methods.name: prodMakeFeatureTree
methods.description: Builds a hierarchical feature tree for product variants based on feature order and availability.

methods.name: prodGetFeatures
methods.description: Retrieves features of a product filtered by type and/or distinctness.

methods.name: prodFindProduct
methods.description: Fetches a product by its product ID, resolving variants to main product if needed.

methods.name: prodFindAssociatedByType
methods.description: Finds associated products (upgrades, complements, variants) by product ID and association type.

methods.name: quickAddVariant
methods.description: Creates or updates a variant product linked to a base product, including features.

methods.name: quickCreateVirtualWithVariants
methods.description: Creates a virtual product and associates multiple variant products with it, attaching features.

methods.name: updateProductIfAvailableFromShipment
methods.description: Reactivates a product based on inventory data if the product is discontinued.

methods.name: addAdditionalViewForProduct
methods.description: Uploads and attaches an additional media view (image) to a product.
